brief:
Israeli forces carried out demolition operations in the cooperation zone area of Nablus city, according to Maan Wire. The demolitions targeted multiple structures located within the designated zone, an area that falls under joint Palestinian-Israeli administrative arrangements established under Oslo Accords framework provisions.

The operation adds to an escalating pattern of demolitions affecting Palestinian communities across the West Bank. Structures in the cooperation zone, which straddles areas of shared jurisdiction, have faced repeated Israeli military action over recent years. Palestinian residents in the zone have increasingly faced displacement threats as demolition orders continue to expand across the territory.
title: Israeli forces demolish structures in Nablus cooperation zone
